Messages.Author: Ankha
Messages.Body:
Name: Weight of Ages
Cardtype: Event
Requires an anarch.
During your discard phase, move this card to a vampire with capacity 8 or more controlled by another Methuselah, if able. This vampire doesn't untap as normal and can burn 1 blood to untap.

Prince of Paris, France

Ratings Coordinator, Rules Director
